record.question: A, in support of a just claim which B has against Z for one thousand rupees, falsely swears on a trial that he heard Z admit the justice of B's claim. A has given false evidence under _________.
record.explanation: Under BNS Section 227, falsely swearing in support of a claim constitutes giving false evidence.
